Interface Asyncc.Callback<T>

public static interface Asyncc.Callback<T> extends Asyncc.IAsyncCallback<T,Throwable>
Throwable-fixed shorthand for IAsyncCallback<T, Throwable>. Same rationale as Asyncc.Task: drop the redundant , Throwable from explicitly-typed callback references.
